title: Immigration arrests continue on Gulf Coast - NewsBreak
text: UPDATE (8:30 p.m.) : News 5 has learned more information regarding the immigration arrests that took place yesterday and today. On Aug. 5, 13 individuals were located through traffic-related incidents in Baldwin County. Three individuals were arrested on other criminal charges. Individuals working at a construction site near Three Notch Road and Schillinger Road were arrested on Aug. 6 in Mobile County. When the Mobile FBI arrived at the site, eight of the individuals fled to a nearby culvert. They were later located and surrendered to agents. “We saw quite a few criminal histories, those that were prior reentries, and specifically what we didn’t post (on Facebook)– There were those with final orders of deportation already. And that’s specifically from the Mobile side,” Assistant Special Agent in Charge of the Mobile FBI Parker Still said. MOBILE, Ala. (WKRG) — Immigration enforcement officials have arrested several individuals on Aug. 5 and 6, according to a Mobile FBI Facebook post . Operations took place in various parts of Mobile and Baldwin Counties, with 24 individuals being arrested. According to the post, those arrested allegedly have prior convictions involving forgery, assault, DUI, and immigration offenses. The post did not name the individuals. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WKRG News 5.
